def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    dark_items = image_patch.find("large dark item")
    car_patches = image_patch.find("car")
    if not dark_items or not car_patches:
        return image_patch
    car_center_x = (car_patches[0].left + car_patches[0].right) / 2
    closest_dark_item = None
    min_distance = float('inf')
    for item in dark_items:
        item_center_x = (item.left + item.right) / 2
        distance_to_car = abs(item_center_x - car_center_x)
        if distance_to_car < min_distance:
            min_distance = distance_to_car
            closest_dark_item = item
    return closest_dark_item
